name: Plum
source:
Plum is one of the last survivors of a rare race of animal people known as the Aprasas, who now are pretty much extinct except for the Aprasas guardians of the elemental shrines. Although not overly intelligent, he has a very sweet and innocent personality, tending to be kind to anyone. His family was killed by the bounty hunter Lhodo, so he cursed Lhodo into the body of a female, which was the first person Lhodo had killed, and is now being hunted by Lhodo. He either becomes an ally to Alex or Platina, and whichever side he chooses, Lhodo will be on the opposite side.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/apo/apoa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
